marketing_wrapper: Heavy. 01 is pure brand art (logo, sleeping orange-dot character on layered yellow/orange hills, award laurels; no UI). 02-06 put a simplified, drawn device frame (no notch, generic) on the same yellow/orange layered-hill backdrop under a two-tone caption, and each enlarges one card that breaks out of the frame. The UI occupies roughly 65-75% of each frame, but the pop-out cards are staged. 03 shows an Android-style status bar, so frames may be cross-platform or dated relative to 8.42.1.

typography.display: Custom rounded geometric grotesque in bold for headlines and card titles (consistent with the documented Aperçu-derived proprietary face; exact cut unsure)
typography.body: custom - same family at regular/medium for meta and descriptions; not SF
typography.weights: Bold titles, medium/regular meta; captions mix dark-brown bold with orange bold highlight words
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence/title case throughout, normal tracking, no all-caps

palette.accent_strategy: Per-content: each category/course tile carries its own saturated illustration colour (orange, purple, pink, blue). Brand orange/yellow dominate artwork; a single blue is reserved for primary play/begin CTAs. Sleep section switches to a navy dark theme with lavender illustrations.
palette.source: palette.json 02 (#faf7f4 off-white canvas), 05/06 (#ffffff surfaces), 03 (#101340/#06092a sleep dark, #5431a5 purple backdrop), 01 (#ff7400, #ffe14f brand); dark-brown text and blue CTA matched visually

shape.radius_language: large: ~16pt cards and category tiles, fully pill CTAs (Play, Begin Course, teacher choice), circular back button and avatar crops
shape.borders_shadows: Light cards use a thin light-grey 1pt border rather than shadow; staged pop-out cards carry a soft shadow (marketing); search field outlined

density: low-medium: generous padding, one card per row with illustration thumbnail right; 2x2 category grid
layout: Today: greeting row with heart/history/bell icons, 'Start your day' heading, vertical timeline (dashed line with dot markers) of content cards each with a thumbnail illustration. Explore: search field, 2x2 coloured category tiles, list of full-width coloured course rows. Detail: big illustration hero, title, meta, description, teacher picker, blue pill CTA.
navigation: Visible 3-tab bar: Today, Explore, profile (user's name 'Katie'); outline icons with bold selected state, labels under. Standard back chevron + centred title top bar. Segmented text tabs 'Recent / Recommended' with underline.
imagery_and_icons: Flat vector illustration with rounded blobs and simple closed-eye smiles (sun, clouds, wave, fire, sleepy shapes); teacher photos in circles; small outline UI icons (clock, speaker, pencil), outline tab icons
signature_visual_move: Every piece of content is fronted by a flat, rounded illustration whose blob characters wear the same closed-eye smile as the logo.

direction_fit.secondary: Warm Clinical modifier (calm, readable lists under the art)
direction_fit.why: One consistent illustration hand drives every tile and hero; navigation and lists stay conventional. Character appears as brand smile rather than as a coach state machine.

notes: Blue CTA is the only non-brand hue and is used consistently for 'start' actions. Text is warm dark brown/grey rather than black, matching the 'no pure black' claim in the text record. The card-heavy list layout is the generic part; the illustration system is what makes it ownable.
